Name: JP's Hardcore Mines - Mine Elevator
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][i][u]Hardcore Mines[/u][/i][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]


[b][font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=5][i]He was a very brave and powerful traveler, but one day he went down into the mines and never returned...[/i][/size][/color][/font][/b]


[size=4][b][font=Georgia]This mod makes the normal mines much more difficult, turning reaching floor 120 into one of the game's biggest challenges.[/font][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff]What to expect in this mod:[/color]
[/font][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Broken elevator: You cannot use the elevator to go up or down or change floors.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Intervals: Instead of the elevator going up or down in increments of 5 floors, you can set the number of floors per interval.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Intermediate Elevator: Allows or disallows the use of elevators outside the configured interval (if the interval is every 10 floors, this option lets you use the elevators on floors 5 and 15, for example).[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Hardcore Stairs: Instead of taking you to the mine entrance, this will make you go up one floor, leaving you at the farthest point from the next staircase.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]No Initial Stairs: Prevents a staircase to the next floor from appearing when you enter the floor.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Hardcore Ladder Spawn: The ladder will not appear randomly; it will only appear once the last rock or monster has fallen.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Trap Block: Prevents you from placing the ladder made from 99 stones.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[/list]

[b][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][i]That's all for now. Always remember to use GMCM for easier mod configuration. I hope you like it. [/i][/size][/color][/font][/b]


[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. [color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color]
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
